subject.title: Prompt-cache prefix churn on OpenAI models: per-turn dynamic injections (message tool hint + volatile system-prompt section) defeat automatic prefix caching

question: Is source-level proof plus the reporter's 2026.6.9 telemetry enough to sponsor a cache-stability fix for `message_tool_only`, or should repair wait for live current-main OpenAI/Codex telemetry?
rationale: The code path is clear, but the item is already marked as needing live repro and no new automated fix PR because the fix crosses provider prompt assembly and channel message-delivery correctness.

options.title: Require live current-main proof first
options.body: Keep the issue open and ask for maintainer-run or reporter-provided redacted OpenAI/Codex telemetry before approving implementation.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow source-backed fix
options.body: Authorize a focused PR that stabilizes tool schemas and relocates per-turn guidance, with tests required before any live proof claim.

options.title: Fold into a broader cache umbrella
options.body: Move the remaining work under a broader prompt-cache tracker only if maintainers explicitly accept losing this issue as the canonical delivery-mode churn case.

recommendation.title: Require live current-main proof first
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and ask for maintainer-run or reporter-provided redacted OpenAI/Codex telemetry before approving implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the freshest history on session-stable binding facts and per-turn message-tool delivery prompt behavior.
